27768.overview:
Card game based on the anime series X/1999.

The battle is done using cards, and there are cards with various properties such as defense, attack, recovery, etc. Depending on the combination, special attacks and continuous attacks can also be done. There are more than 250 cards in all, and all cards are related to "X". The collected cards can be used to play and exchange with friends.

27771.overview: The game is made up of four modes, including the familiar Trial, Battle and Puzzle modes from the PlayStation version plus a WonderSwan original, Dance with AQUI-chan's dice. It's a mode that incorporates sound elements into the XI Little system, while erasing the dice rising from below.
